audience: Accountants who match customer invoices with the payments received for them.
goal: **Reconcile journal items**: open the **Reconcile** screen, find the customer's lines on the **receivable account**, tick the **payment** line and the **invoice** line, press **Reconcile**, and check that the account is matched to zero.
before: You can open the **Accounting** app and its **Accounting** menu.
An unreconciled **customer invoice** and an unreconciled **payment** exist for the same customer on the same receivable account.
The invoice and the payment have the same amount, so the match is complete (otherwise Odoo keeps the difference open).
outcome: The invoice line and the payment line are **matched**, with a matching number.
The receivable account shows a balance of **0** and **(0)** lines in the unreconciled list.
You know the Reconcile screen only lists items still waiting to be matched.
notes: The screenshots were captured by an automated run on a **test database**. The red banner at the top ("Database neutralized for testing") only appears on test databases. The figures are test data: a **1.00** invoice (Sales/2026/00001) and a **1.00** payment (PBNK1/2026/00001) for the customer **Engineer - Production**.

The automated run **really reconciles** the two lines, and a reconciliation cannot be undone by the test. So each run **uses up one invoice and payment pair**. The run finds a pair by itself, preferring a small one, and it is skipped unless `TOUR_ALLOW_WRITES=true`.
The Reconcile screen opens grouped by **Account**, then **Partner**. Always reconcile **within one account and one partner**.
Debit and credit must add up to zero for a full match. If they do not, Odoo keeps the difference open as a partial reconciliation.

The matched lines **do not come back** into this list, even after you remove the **Unreconciled** filter: the screen only ever shows items still waiting to be matched. To see the **Matching number** itself, open **Accounting › Journal Items**.

phases.title: Open the Reconcile screen
phases.summary: Find the Reconcile tool in the Accounting menu and check its filter.
phases.checkpoint: The **Journal Items to reconcile** list is open with the **Unreconciled** filter.

phases.title: Pick the invoice and the payment
phases.summary: Open the customer's group and tick the two lines.
phases.checkpoint: The **payment** and the **invoice** are both ticked, and the totals at the bottom add up to zero.

phases.title: Reconcile and check
phases.summary: Press Reconcile and confirm the account is clear.
phases.checkpoint: The receivable account shows **(0)** lines and a zero balance.

glossary.meaning: Match an invoice with the payment that settles it, so that Odoo knows the invoice is paid.
A journal item that has not been matched yet.
The account that holds what customers owe you. Invoices are debits, payments are credits.
A number Odoo gives to the lines that were matched together.
The part of a line that is still not matched.
A match where debit and credit do not cancel out; the difference stays open.

1.title: Open the Accounting menu
1.do: In the top menu bar, click **Accounting**.
actions: Look at the menu bar across the top.
1.see: A drop-down with the Accounting entries, including the **Actions** group.
1.why: Every accounting action lives here, including the Reconcile tool.
1.tip: If **Accounting** is hidden, widen the window; narrow windows hide the last entries behind a **+**.

2.title: Click Reconcile under Actions
2.do: Scroll to the **Actions** group and click **Reconcile**.
actions: Scroll down the menu to the **Actions** group.
2.why: This opens the list of journal items that are still waiting to be matched.

3.title: Check the Unreconciled filter
3.do: Look at the search box: the **Unreconciled** filter is already on.
3.where: Journal Items to reconcile > search box
actions: Look at the search box at the top.
Find the **Unreconciled** filter and the **Account › Partner** grouping.
3.see: The **Unreconciled** filter, with the lines grouped by **Account**, then **Partner**.
3.why: Only journal items still waiting to be matched are listed here.

4.title: Expand the customer group
4.do: Open the receivable account, then the customer.
4.where: Journal Items to reconcile > 121000 Account Receivable > customer
actions: Find the account you need: **121000 Account Receivable**, holding 1.00 debit (the invoice) and 1.00 credit (the payment).
Click the partner line **Engineer - Production** under it to open the individual journal items.
4.see: The customer's journal items: the payment and the invoice.
4.why: Always reconcile within one account and one partner.
4.warning: The same customer also appears under other accounts (outstanding receipts, payable, sales). Open the group under the **receivable** account.

5.title: Select the payment line
5.do: Tick the box on the **payment** line.
actions: Find the payment line **PBNK1/2026/00001**, the 1.00 credit received from the customer.
Tick the box at its left.
5.see: The line is ticked and the top shows **1 selected**.
5.why: The payment is one half of the match.

6.title: Select the invoice line
6.do: Tick the box on the customer **invoice** line.
actions: Find the customer invoice line **Sales/2026/00001**, the 1.00 debit.
Tick the box at its left.
6.see: **2 selected**. The totals at the bottom show 1.00 debit and 1.00 credit.
6.why: Debit and credit must add up to zero for a full match. If they do not, Odoo keeps the difference open as a partial reconciliation.
6.warning: Check the two lines are for the **same customer** before you go on.

7.title: Click the Reconcile button
actions: Click the **Reconcile** button at the top.
7.see: The two lines disappear from the list.
7.why: Odoo matches them, drops the residual to zero, gives them a Matching number and marks the invoice as paid.
7.warning: Click **Reconcile** only once. Odoo applies it a moment after the click.

8.title: Confirm the lines are matched
8.do: Look at **121000 Account Receivable**: it now shows **(0)**.
8.where: Journal Items to reconcile > 121000 Account Receivable
actions: Find the receivable account in the list.
Read the number of lines and the balance.
8.see: **121000 Account Receivable (0)** with a zero balance. The customer's group is gone.
8.why: Both lines have left the unreconciled list, which means the match worked.

9.title: Remove the Unreconciled filter
9.where: Journal Items to reconcile > Unreconciled filter
actions: Click the **×** next to **Unreconciled** in the search box.
9.see: The filter is removed, but the matched lines do not come back.
9.why: This screen only ever shows items still waiting to be matched, so an account that has disappeared from here is fully reconciled.
9.tip: To see the **Matching number** itself, open **Accounting › Journal Items**. That completes the tour: pick the invoice and the payment, reconcile, and check the account.
